findings.evidence: Line 354 assumes only [Field K]. In characteristic 3, 2ω₀−ω₁ = 2ω₁−ω₀ = −(ω₀+ω₁), so formalCharacter_slThree_adjoint gives multiplicity 3 at each nonzero weight; the identity matrix is nonzero, central and trace zero. At r=1 in characteristic 2, ε₀=ε₁, contradicting the multiplicity-one descriptions of formalCharacter_specialLinear_pi and formalCharacter_specialLinear_dual.
findings.fix: Qualify the classical interpretation and hexagon claims at lines 33–36, 348–349, 442–445 and 505–506 by characteristic zero, and explain collisions in positive characteristic. Also qualify the general standard/dual multiplicity-one claims at lines 254 and 274.
findings.issue: The unrestricted-field API is described as having six distinct roots of multiplicity one and an irreducible adjoint module. In characteristic 3 its support has only three points, and the adjoint module contains the scalar matrices as a proper invariant subspace.

summary: The character identities count repeated weights correctly, but their advertised multiplicities, hexagonal support, and irreducible-module interpretation fail in allowed positive characteristics.
